text:
alex: starting rollout v2.8.0 -> eu1 (canary 5%) — kicking off post-deploy smoke probes
deploy-bot: Rollout started: release=v2.8.0 region=eu1 canary=5% id=rb-3111112222
deploy-bot: smoke-probe: kv-prefix-check p95=860ms threshold=500ms — FAIL
priya: seeing the same on telemetry dashboards, embed/predict endpoints p95 drifted ~2x
sam: logs? any stack traces or 503s?
nora: attaching quick tail snippet:
```
2026-03-12T10:05:40Z eu1-embed-3 ERROR request_id=xyz backend=embed-cache timeout after 450ms
2026-03-12T10:05:41Z eu1-kv-1 WARN slow response p95=820ms logsample=...
```
alex: can we narrow to a specific node pool? which hosts triggered the probe?
deploy-bot: probe-hit-nodes: eu1-pool-a: 8/16, eu1-pool-b: 4/16
priya: pool-a hosts show elevated GC and higher host-level cpu, looks correlated with a batching change in v2.8.0
sam: if it's batching change, we should avoid rollback of whole release — pin canary to previous stable (v2.7.9) and block expansion until investigation
nora: created ticket INF-3245 with perf traces and linked to the rollout, added @oncall
alex: agreed. hold full rollout. apply pin to eu1 canary and pause change window :warning:
priya: command to pin: `deployctl pin --region eu1 --release v2.7.9 --target canary`
sam: run it now?
alex: go for it. ping when complete.
deploy-bot: Pinning in progress...
deploy-bot: Pin applied: eu1 canary -> v2.7.9 :white_check_mark:
alex: nice. please keep eu1 at canary=5% pinned and do not expand. schedule a targeted redeploy for the pool-a hosts once root cause is identified
priya: will reproduce locally with the batching flag, adding evaluation run to INF-3245
sam: adding short blameless post-check: check kv cache hit ratios, GC logs, kernel latency across pools
nora: update release notes: rolled back canary expansion in eu1 due to postdeploy smoke failures, see INF-3245
alex: thanks everyone. I'll update the change window and notify product and support. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for eu1, full rollout blocked until open ticket cleared
priya: leaving some synthetic jobs running at reduced rate to gather more traces
sam: any ETA on RCA?
priya: preliminary root-cause estimate ~3-4h, will update ticket
alex: ok — great containment. follow-ups in INF-3245, moving to follow-up thread after RCA.
